runs.title: Charizard HOME render, unedited RGBA · seed 61061
runs.question: Does the unedited PokeAPI HOME render improve Charizard likeness and anatomy over the dramatic Telegram cutout with all generation settings held fixed?

recipe.preprocess: No external edits or segmentation. Original alpha; native Hunyuan recenter/resize only.

evaluation.notes: More faithful HOME-like silhouette, rounded torso and recognizable three-finger hands than the paired dramatic-source generation. Both HOME seeds still fail complete geometry acceptance. Seed61061 retains a continuous tail/flame relationship better than61062. No human approval recorded.
unresolved: Face-like structures hallucinated on rear of head.
Oversized broad tail loop and shallow reconstructed body depth.
Fused finger tips, rounded horn/eye details, corrugated wing membranes.
Flame should become a separate effect; seed61062 has an obvious disconnected flame.
No UVs, PBR textures, retopology, rig or deformation validation.

confounds: Source family changes pose, lighting, silhouette and alpha together; this comparison cannot isolate which image property helped. Original Bulbasaur settings are unknown.

runs.title: Charizard Official illustration, unedited RGBA · seed 61061 · same latent, octree 256
runs.question: Does lower extraction resolution reduce surface noise while preserving the exact sampled shape?

recipe.preprocess: No external edits or segmentation. Original alpha; native Hunyuan recenter/resize only.

evaluation.notes: Official artwork does not fix hidden-side reconstruction. Tail is a broad flattened loop, flame is detached, rear head has extraneous protrusions. Lower extraction resolution retains these defects. No production acceptance.
unresolved: Tail must be rebuilt with a rounded taper and continuous attachment.
Flame needs a separate effect at the corrected tail tip.
Head, horns, fingers and feet require anatomical correction.
No UVs, textures, rig or animations.

evidence.label: Identical smooth-shaded clay review; geometry unchanged

Original Bulbasaur generation recipe is unknown; it is not a controlled member of this cohort.

Failure is operational evidence, not a comparison of rendered quality.
